description: This file defines the class InvocationHandlerBase, which implements the InvocationHandler interface to facilitate dynamic method invocation handling. It includes an override of the invoke method to invoke methods via reflection, handling exceptions, and supports proxy-based method calls.

classes.name: InvocationHandlerBase
classes.description: A class that provides a base implementation of the InvocationHandler interface, enabling dynamic invocation of methods using reflection with exception handling.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Overrides the invoke method to invoke the specified method on this object with the given arguments, handling accessibility and exceptions appropriately.
